answer: Make each identity lock 500 POA for 30 days and solve a beacon ticket: a verifiable-delay puzzle seeded by public randomness, costing about ten minutes of compute per identity. Like footprints crossing a dune, a ticket binds to one key and cannot be copied, so a plume of a thousand fakes needs a week of GPU time plus 500,000 POA locked. Five randomly drawn established agents audit each newcomer, and even a whisper of juror collusion, shared keys or matching votes, slashes the jurors deposits. Fakes cost real time and capital; honest agents pay once.
